hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of high-speed traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk on either side of the roadway, forcing any pedestrians to walk on the grass or the road shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and background along the road edges

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes, a concrete median barrier, and guardrails suggest high-speed traffic with no physical measures to protect pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: Absence of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals for a very wide, multi-lane road, making crossing extremely dangerous.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the road

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of traffic without a protected refuge or signalized crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with minimal friction encourage high vehicle speeds adjacent to the pedestrian walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which can compromise pedestrian safety and security during nighttime hours.

hazards.name: Absence of raised curb
hazards.description: The transition from the road to the grass buffer is flush, providing no physical barrier to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the edge of the roadway

hazards.name: High-speed traffic
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway design encourages high vehicle speeds adjacent to a residential area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated walking area, forcing any pedestrian to walk on the high-speed roadway or shoulder.

hazards.name: Physical Barriers
hazards.description: The guardrail acts as a physical barrier that could trap a pedestrian on the roadway side in an emergency.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground along the grassy area

hazards.name: Lack of crossing opportunities
hazards.description: A long stretch of multi-lane road without any marked crossings or refuge islands makes it dangerous for pedestrians to cross between residential areas and the park-like space opposite.

hazards.name: Undefined roadway edge
hazards.description: The lack of a raised curb between the dirt buffer and the roadway can lead to vehicle encroachment or tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing the buffer.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, at the transition between the dirt strip and the road

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration.

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated paved space, forcing them to walk on uneven grass or in the high-speed travel lanes.

hazards.name: Excessive unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Crossing the multi-lane road and wide median requires traversing a significant distance without any designated or protected pedestrian space.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the grass or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and background along the road edges

hazards.name: High-Speed Multi-Lane Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or crossing infrastructure are visible for a significant distance, forcing unsafe midblock crossings.

hazards.name: Litter and Debris
hazards.description: Visible litter in the grass buffer area can degrade the pedestrian experience and indicate poor maintenance.

hazards.name: Degraded pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: The paved walkway within the median is cracked and uneven, posing a trip hazard for pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the median walkway

hazards.name: High vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The posted speed limit of 40 mph significantly increases the risk of fatality or severe injury in the event of a pedestrian collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Speed limit sign on the right side of the road

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for other modes or shorter crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Construct Separated Walkway
interventions.description: Install a physically separated sidewalk or multi-use path along the corridor to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Grade-Separated Crossing
interventions.description: Given the high-speed nature of the road, a pedestrian bridge or underpass would be necessary to allow safe crossing.

interventions.title: Road Diet or Traffic Calming
interventions.description: If this is an urban arterial, reducing lane counts and widths could slow traffic and create space for pedestrian facilities.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns and pedestrian-actuated warning beacons.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway edge to prevent further degradation and improve the interface between the road and the curb.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Grade-Separated Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a pedestrian bridge or underpass to allow safe crossing of the high-speed corridor without conflict with vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation with Physical Buffer
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a wide planting strip or a crash-rated barrier.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crossing with a raised median refuge island to break up the crossing distance and improve pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Street Tree Infill
interventions.description: Planting additional street trees within the grass buffer to provide a stronger physical and psychological barrier between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures at nearby intersections to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signs to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a buffer zone.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths and number of lanes to lower vehicle speeds and decrease the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage or a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB).

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower driving speeds and potentially repurpose space for a bike lane or wider buffer.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian-scale lighting is provided along the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Curb installation
interventions.description: Adding a raised curb would provide a physical barrier and better define the edge of the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as lane narrowing or speed reduction signage to lower vehicle speeds on this residential-adjacent arterial.

interventions.title: Separated Multi-use Path
interventions.description: Construct a paved path separated from the high-speed roadway by a significant buffer or barrier to provide a safe route for pedestrians and cyclists.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Increase the density of street trees in the buffer zone to provide vertical friction and further psychologically slow drivers.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale or standard street lighting to improve visibility and security after dark.

interventions.title: Install Concrete Curbing
interventions.description: Provide a vertical curb to clearly define the roadway edge and prevent vehicles from driving onto the unpaved buffer.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Plant street trees within the buffer zone to provide shade and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Buffered Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert excess roadway width into a buffered bike lane to increase the separation between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads at the intersection to manage crossings.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the existing median to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Increase the frequency and brightness of street lighting to improve pedestrian visibility at night.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding street lights would improve visibility and safety for pedestrians using the sidewalk after dark.

interventions.title: Enhanced Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular cleaning schedules to remove litter and maintain the grass buffer area.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the paved area in the median to provide a safe, level waiting space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing crosswalk to high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Speed Limit Reduction
interventions.description: Lower the posted speed limit to 25 or 30 mph to align with a residential and pedestrian-accessible environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK) or Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 6-8 feet to improve comfort and accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Regular removal of litter and debris from the public right-of-way to maintain a clean and safe walking environment.
